title: Collect a live large-workspace runtime receipt for vaporize list-schemes
createdBy: wd capture after 2026-06-14 Vaporize CUJ-20 list-schemes implementation

historicalContent.createdBy: wd capture after 2026-06-14 Vaporize CUJ-20 list-schemes implementation
historicalContent.description: CUJ-20 has focused tests and release evidence, but the live rismay-substrate.xcworkspace probe exceeded the interactive window and produced no receipt. Before marketing or release language claims large-workspace runtime behavior, Vaporize needs a persisted receipt from a real large workspace list-schemes invocation.
acceptanceCriteria: Run vaporize list-schemes against the live rismay-substrate.xcworkspace or the current canonical substrate warehouse workspace.
Persist stdout/stderr and the typed list-schemes receipt under the Vaporize v0.0.1 evidence directory.
Record duration, exit status, scheme count, workspace path, and whether the command used xcodebuild through CommonProcess.
Update CUJ-20 evidence, release-doctor inputs, and benchmark/size documentation only after the receipt exists.
If the command times out or fails, preserve the failure receipt and classify the release gate as pending instead of passing.
operatorQuotes: basically we use the workspace to build and list all the available schemes - vaporize passes through to those commands.
exactly! we map our custom xcodegen flow to create the projects just like we need, then leverage xcoudebuild!
